title: A Phone Company Built an SUV Faster Than Porsche #shorts

scenes.text: A phone company just built an SUV that laps the Nürburgring faster than Porsche.
Xiaomi makes phones. It announced its car plan in twenty twenty-one. Apple tried for ten years, then quit.
The test: Germany's Nordschleife. The SUV record belonged to Porsche and Audi, just under seven forty.
Xiaomi's YU7 GT: seven twenty-two. Almost fourteen seconds faster.
Two motors, about a thousand horsepower, and a starting price around fifty-seven thousand dollars in China.
The catch: semi-slick tires from a track package not on sale yet. Later, it lapped the Ring driving itself.
How did a phone company do in five years what Apple couldn't in ten? Tell me below, and follow EV Drive.
